name: LFM2 1.2B
description: A balanced everyday model for thoughtful answers, writing, planning, and general tasks.
bestFor: Quick everyday questions, short drafts, summaries, and lightweight planning. It is a small, responsive general-purpose option for straightforward tasks; larger models may do better with complex reasoning or long instructions.

name: Qwen3 0.6B
description: A compact, fast model for everyday questions, drafts, and short planning tasks.
bestFor: Fast responses, simple explanations, short writing, and basic everyday tasks. Its compact size favors speed and a smaller download over depth on difficult, multi-step questions.

name: Qwen3 1.7B
description: A capable small reasoning model for writing, analysis, and everyday problem solving.
bestFor: More involved questions, step-by-step problem solving, analysis, and writing. It offers more capacity than the 0.6B option while remaining a relatively compact on-device model.

name: MiniCPM5 2B
description: An efficient modern model for coding, math, tool use, and capable everyday assistance.
bestFor: Coding help, mathematical problem solving, structured planning, tool-oriented prompts, and demanding everyday questions where strong capability per download byte matters more than the absolute fastest response.

name: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507
description: A premium non-thinking Qwen model for stronger writing, analysis, coding, and instruction following.
bestFor: Complex writing, careful analysis, coding, multilingual questions, and difficult instructions where users accept a larger download and higher memory use for the catalog's strongest general text tier.

name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
description: A lightweight instruction-following model for quick, general-purpose conversations.
bestFor: Instruction following, rewriting, summaries, and general-purpose conversation. Choose it for a lightweight assistant-style model; it is text-only and does not interpret image attachments directly.

name: SmolLM3 3B
description: A stronger compact model for more involved writing, coding, and multilingual conversations.
bestFor: Longer writing, coding help, reasoning, and multilingual conversation. Its 3B size can handle more involved prompts than the smallest options, but needs a newer iPhone and more memory.

name: Gemma 3 1B Instruct
description: Google's compact instruction model for concise writing, summaries, and everyday questions.
bestFor: Concise instruction following, summaries, and general questions. This quantized 1B version is text-only, so use the separate vision model for questions about images.

name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct
description: A newer, efficient Liquid AI model for multilingual conversations and everyday tasks.
bestFor: Efficient everyday conversation and multilingual short-form writing. Its small footprint makes it a practical alternative for quick chats and summaries on supported iPhones.

name: Granite 3.3 2B Instruct
description: IBM's efficient instruction model for structured answers, documents, and practical tasks.
bestFor: Structured responses, practical question answering, and working with user-provided text. It is a good fit for clear, organized summaries and document-focused prompts.

name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 1.5B
description: A compact reasoning model for math, logic, and detailed problem solving.
bestFor: Math, logic, and multi-step reasoning. It may take longer and produce more detailed responses than a regular chat model, so it is best when careful problem solving matters more than speed.

name: Qwen2.5 Coder 3B Instruct
description: A coding-focused model for explaining, writing, and debugging software locally.
bestFor: Writing, explaining, and debugging code; useful for programming questions and snippets. It is specialized for coding rather than being the best choice for every general conversation.

name: Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct
description: Microsoft's multilingual compact model for general chat, reasoning, and lightweight coding.
bestFor: General instruction following, multilingual chat, and lightweight coding help. Its larger size can help with more involved prompts, while requiring a newer, more capable iPhone.

name: SmolVLM2 500M
description: A lightweight vision model for understanding images and answering questions about them.
bestFor: Describing attached images, recognizing visible objects and actions, and reading clear text with a smaller download. It is the preferred lightweight vision bridge for Beacon’s text-only chat models.

name: Qwen2-VL 2B
description: A compact vision-language model for understanding images and answering questions about them.
bestFor: Answering questions about attached images, describing scenes, and reading visible text. It is the catalog’s vision model; download it before retrying a chat that includes an image.
